what: Time Use Data from the General Social Survey of Canada to Study Active Travel
title: Time Use Data from the General Social Survey of Canada to Study Active Travel
text: Bruno Santos, School Earth, Environment Society, McMaster University Mahdis Mogadhasi, School Earth, Environment Society, McMaster University Antonio Paez, School Earth, Environment Society, McMaster University paper describes {ActiveCA}, open data product Canadian time use data. {ActiveCA} R data package contains analysis-ready data related active travel spanning almost 40 years, extracted Cycles 2 (1986), 7 (1992), 12 (1998), 19 (2005), 24 (2010), 29 (2015), 34 (2022) Time Use Survey (TUS) General Social Survey (GSS). Active travel episodes characterized mode, walking part every cycle bicycling starting 1992. attributes active trips types locations origins destinations, duration trips, episode weights expanding trips population-wide estimates. Based year survey, variety locations coded. earlier cycles, include home, work school, ’s home, whereas later cycles augmented locations grocery stores, restaurants, outdoor destinations, others. geographical resolution includes province whether episode urban rural setting. https://doi-org.libaccess.lib.mcmaster.ca/10.1177/23998083251374724
